contracts: The full profile callback publishes CAMERA_SCROLL_DELTA_TABLE at 0x0000693E.
The reduced profile callback publishes the same table at offset 0x14, ROM address 0x00006952.
The tail profile callback publishes the same table at offset 0x1C, ROM address 0x0000695A.
The level camera-scroll consumer reads signed delta words through CAMERA_SCROLL_DATA_CURSOR; the callback family has no separate storage or side effect.
limitations: Full/reduced/tail describe the selected table positions and observed profile lengths, not an exhaustive semantic model of every camera motion that invokes them.
The legacy ROM-offset names remain aliases for historical findings and downstream references.
conclusion: The three AnimationVM camera-scroll callbacks now have stable profile identities while preserving their exact table offsets and cursor-publication contract.
